description: This file defines the DeviceAdapter class, a RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of smart home devices with TV remote interaction support. It manages device card views, including focus handling and toggle behavior, for a smart home TV interface.

classes.name: DeviceAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for device cards with focus and toggle support

classes.name: DeviceViewHolder
classes.description: Inner class managing individual device card views and interactions

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds device data to the view holder and sets up interaction handlers

methods.name: updateCardState
methods.description: Updates the visual appearance of the device card based on power state

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds device data to the ViewHolder for a given position

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of devices
